# Vo Creations

> Vo Creations is a UGC agency for AI startups and consumer apps. It builds and runs an in-house UGC program: trained creators, organic talking-head videos, and UGC ads made from what already works.

Vo Creations trains its own creators, then runs them as a brand's content team across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook. The format is talking-head storytelling, not text-on-screen templates.

## Facts

- 1B+ views generated
- 1000+ vetted in-house creators trained through mentorship
- 5M+ users converted
- 2,400+ videos produced a month on a campaign
- First posts live in 10-14 days
- 90-day minimum, then month to month
- Campaigns start at $50K/month. Creator bonuses are billed separately. No refunds.
- Founders: Thienvu Vo (Richmond, VA) and Daniel Yun (Los Angeles, CA)
- New York. Founded 2025.

## Who we serve

AI startups and consumer apps that want an in-house UGC program: trained creators, organic talking-head video, then ads made from the videos that already earned the view.

## When to use us

When you want the program run for you, not a folder of clips. First posts go live in 10-14 days. The minimum is 90 days so accounts can warm up and a few testing cycles can find the format. After that the work is month to month.

## Not a fit

Not for one-off videos or small budgets. Campaigns start at $50K/month. Creator bonuses are billed separately. No refunds.
